name: parcad
description: Parametric CAD you write as code: model 3D-printable parts in a JavaScript DSL, evaluated by an exact B-rep kernel.
long_description: ParCAD builds parts from a small JavaScript DSL and evaluates them with OpenCASCADE. Every report is measured from the geometry: bounds, volume, what the part stands on, whether it fits the object it holds. Parts are saved to ~/Documents/parcad, and the whole app is in your browser at http://127.0.0.1:4242 while the extension runs. It runs the parcad you already have from Homebrew or the app, and its own copy only when neither is installed.
